Author: Tensho
Name: Tensho Assistant
Description:
Everyday tools in one window (/tensho), with a guide and help on every page.

Items and storage (bags, retainers, saddlebags, armoury chest, glamour dresser, armoire), inventory
sorting rules, market listings and prices, retainer sale prices compared on a click, recipes, a crafting
simulator and solver, gathering and fishing with Eorzea time windows and weather, a map that replaces
the game map (quests, leves, FATEs, gathering points, vendors, aether currents, teleport costs), weather,
alarms and reminders, free company voyages and builds, quests and rewards, collections with how to
obtain each item, a gear planner (materia, try on, build sharing), duty and monster loot, Beastmaster
information, Fashion Report hints, Mini Cactpot, Triple Triad helpers (against NPCs only), character
stats, macro chains and a Credits page listing every source.

Network: community data (Universalis, Garland Tools, FFXIV Console Games Wiki, Teamcraft bite times,
PaissaDB open plots, and files hosted on GitHub: LuminaSupplemental, GatherBuddy, FFXIVGachaSpreadsheet; the shared discoveries exchange through your GitHub account, only after you connect it)
is requested over HTTPS only when you open or hover the matching tool, click, or a setting asks for it,
with bounded replies and a disk cache. Each source has a switch in Settings > Advanced. This plugin's own
repository is read on a click for the gallery of community tools (data only, no code) and the help
videos. Nothing about your character is sent, except on options that are off by default: posting Tensho
alarms and currency cap alerts to a Discord webhook you enter, with your character's name only if you ask
for it. An item's page on the wiki or the Lodestone, and partake.gg (player events), open in your browser
only on a click or a /tensho command. Reporting a problem opens a prefilled form in your browser; you read
it and send it yourself.

Actions that reach the game (teleport, applying a sort, a macro chain, writing crafting macros, opening
Try On, equipping a gear set, sending the hunt train call to the chat channel you choose) start only when you click them. Game
alarms are created with /alarm when you add an alarm with the « game alarms » setting on (off by default)
or press Send. One setting, off by default, acts without a click: wearing the title you chose for a job
when you change job. No automation of crafting, dialogues or loot, no PvP feature, no parser.

AI disclosure: the code and the icon were generated with an AI coding agent (Claude), directed and tested
in game by the author.

Languages: English and French; German and Japanese: menu titles only.
Punchline: One window for everyday tools: items, crafting, gathering, map, collections and more.

## 0.1033.0
- Desktop application: automatic update from the repository's GitHub releases, with no step for the user (X-121). At start (and on « Check for update »), it asks for the release that has the installed plugin's version, else the latest Stable release (HTTPS, no player data, no request when the versions are already the same); it checks that it is a published Stable release of this repository, downloads TenshoAssistant.Desktop.zip from the repository's download address, compares its SHA-256 with the one published in the same release (TenshoAssistant.Desktop.zip.sha256), installs it beside (%LOCALAPPDATA%\TenshoAssistant\Desktop\versions) after checking the versions of the app and plugin inside, and keeps the version before. The running exe is never overwritten: the copy started hands over to the newest one at start; the new version restarts by itself only when the window was not used and the catalogues are loaded, otherwise at the next start or on « Restart now ». « Previous version » goes back and sets the version aside; a copy that fails at start goes back to the previous one by itself; « Automatic update » turns it off. Publishing: Verify.ps1 writes the hash and tries the update on a fake local release (install, hand-over, going back, damaged zip and foreign address refused); Release.ps1 refuses a release without the hash and attaches it to the release. Network source declared (SECURITY.md); new FAQ question. Limit stated in SECURITY, the FAQ and the README: without code signing, the hash protects against a damaged file, not against a stolen GitHub account. Repository (D-100, X-123): code of conduct in two languages (CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), CODEOWNERS (owner review requested on other people's pull requests), pre-push hook active on the maintainer's PC, reusing Verify's stamp: no second build after publish.sh. Evidence in docs/evidence (X-121).

## 0.1032.0
- New test tool for Dalamud plugin creators, tools/PluginUiTest (plan 2, D-135): it creates the creator's built plugin the way Dalamud does (constructor and services answered by general stand-ins), draws each of its windows without the game or a real window for N frames and reports exceptions, hangs (timeout) and absent Dalamud members reached, on a PC or in GitHub continuous integration (example workflow in its documentation). Safeguards: it loads only the DLL given (never another author's installed plugin); an analysis of the compiled code finds, before running, the game memory reads reachable from drawing and skips those windows with a clear message; drawing runs in a child process, so a crash or a hang becomes a line of the report; no network request (the plugin's are blocked and recorded); nothing of Dalamud or the game is redistributed; « test tool, not affiliated with the Dalamud team, does not replace Dalamud ». The code shared with the desktop application lives in one library (PluginUiTest.Host), used by both. A sample plugin for the test (one window that works, one that throws, one that reads game memory). No separate repository created. Evidence in docs/evidence (X-120).
